findings: All 87 broad configurations completed all eight pinned records and all three training seeds.
The legacy baseline is best after paired gate penalties; the best unpenalized balanced gain is only 0.039 percent.
Tau and horizontal regularization have a strong interaction. A coarse joint-grid optimum on a face is not sufficient evidence of a global optimum.
Some secondary metrics continue improving at the upper sigma boundary, so that direction is extended jointly with tau and regularization.
The final refinement is four-dimensional: X and Y are independent, with 54 asymmetric combinations and 27 symmetric combinations plus the baseline.

The broad screen and the planned refinement both move the two horizontal axes together or inside a symmetric 0.85-1.45 box, so neither can reach the region deployed OU-III occupies on these same records (x 0.72, y 0.50). The split is therefore searched on its own wide grid before the four-dimensional refinement.
